applies_to: Carrier 30HXA condenserless and 30HXC water-cooled screw chillers, sizes 076-271, Series 9 with ComfortLink controls and the BACnet communication option.
summary: On the 30HX, BACnet MS/TP comes from a UPC Open controller added to the ComfortLink chiller. Its list has about 250 AVs, BVs and three multistate values covering start/stop, control point, demand limit, setpoints, cooler and condenser water temperatures, refrigerant pressures, compressor currents and run hours, and alarm state.
default_device_instance: Network number 16101 followed by the MAC address (MAC 20 gives 1610120)
notes: BACnet comes from the optional UPC Open controller, mounted in the main control box; object names end in _1.
The Network Points List gives a point description, CCN name, read/write, units, default and range for each object; descriptions here are the printed point descriptions.
The table lists multistate values as MSV (mapped as MV here). AV 19 / MV 2 (Alarm State) and AV 58 / MV 5 (Control Mode) share one table row each.
AV 58 Control Mode codes: 0 Service Test, 1 Off-Local, 2 Off-CCN, 3 Off-Clock, 4 Off-Emergency, 5 On-Local, 6 On-CCN, 7 On-Clock.
Emergency Stop (BV 33) is printed as read-only in this table.

Some printed units are clear misprints and are corrected here: Cooling Setpoint 1 (AV 64) has no unit printed (set to °F), Lead/Lag Sequence Select (AV 103) shows °F (removed), circuit starts (AV 33, AV 35) show hr (removed), and "Minimum" is shown as min. Other printed defaults and ranges that look shifted by a row are not carried over.

source.title: 30HXA,HXC076-271 Condenserless and Water-Cooled Chillers with ComfortLink Controls 50/60 Hz, Series 9 - Controls, Start-Up, Operation, Service, and Troubleshooting (Appendix H, BACnet Communication Option, Network Points List)

integration.summary: Address the UPC Open, set the MS/TP DIP switches, and set the control method (OPT2 > CTRL) to CCN. The BMS then starts and stops the chiller with BV 3 (CHIL_S_S) and can write control point and demand limit; read control mode, leaving fluid temperature, capacity and alarm state.
integration.enable: Set the control method (OPT2 > CTRL) to CCN = CCN Control; CHIL_S_S (BV 3) then starts and stops the chiller from the network.
gotchas: Alarm state and control mode exist both as AVs (AV 19, AV 58) and as multistate values (MV 2, MV 5); the alarm codes start at 0 on the AV and at 1 on the MV.
Emergency Stop (BV 33) is listed read-only in the BACnet table, so it is not a BMS command here.
setup: The BACnet option adds a UPC Open controller; it speaks BACnet MS/TP at 9600, 19.2k, 38.4k or 76.8k (Carrier default 76.8k), set on BAS port DIP switches DS1-DS2.
For MS/TP set DS3 to enable, DS4 to E1-485 and the protocol switches DS5-DS8 to MSTP; the EIA-485 jumpers must be set to EIA-485 and 2W.
MAC address from the two rotary switches (tens and ones); the controller reads switches and DIP settings only at power-up.
Device instance is auto-generated as the network number (default 16101) followed by the MAC address, e.g. MAC 20 gives 1610120; change it with i-Vu Tools or a BACview.
Fit a BT485 terminator on the first and last controller of the MS/TP segment.
